why: ChatGPT's answer says one battery is not enough for a Texas home: it suggests two Powerwalls as a starting point, gives a sizing table running from 5–10 kWh for essentials to 27–45 kWh for central AC, and says whole-home integration needs an electrician and extra equipment, but its cards are single batteries only. Whether the set works depends on 240 V split-phase output to start a central AC compressor, and on battery count to reach the kWh for the outage length, so the page should compare an essentials set (inverter + 2 modules) with a whole-home-AC set (inverter + 4 modules, breaker, bus bar) and a multi-day solar kit, all in the Sun Gold Power cart.
